results.title: CSALR Calls for Calm as announcement of results continue
results.description: The Civil Society Alliance on Legal Reforms (CSALR) has called on political party leaders, their supporters and all Zambians to remain calm and respect the electoral process as the counting and announcement of results continue. results.title: Atiku meets all ADC candidates in Adamawa
results.description: Former Vice President and presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Atiku Abubakar, on Saturday received all his fellow party candidates across all elective positions in Adamawa State. The Waziri Adamawa confirmed this in a post on his X handle. He urged them to begin engaging with people through mass mobilisation and voter sensitisation [...] The post Atiku meets all ADC candidates in Adamawa appeared first on Tribune Online .

results.title: Govt Dismisses Social Media Reports of Kafwaya has been Shot
results.description: Government has dismissed social media reports alleging that former Lunte Member of Parliament MUTOTWE KAFWAYA was shot and admitted to Maina Soko Medical Centre . The reports, allegedly attributed to NRPUP running mate MAKEBI ZULU, claimed that Mr KAFWAYA had been shot and was receiving treatment at the hospital. results.title: UPND Sweeps All 3 Mazabuka Seats, Nkombo Falls
results.description: By Brandinah Ng’andu The UPND has won all the three Parliamentary Seats in Mazabuka district. Mazabuka Central Constituency Returning Officer CHILALA BBALO declared UPND’s VINCENT LILANDA as duly elected Member of Parliament for Mazabuka central constituency this morning around 03:00hrs. The former Mazabuka Mayor polled 20,420 votes defeating Independent candidate GARY NKOMBO, who polled 10,720 [...]

results.title: UPND Secures Both Kafue East and West Seats
results.description: By Memory Bbuku The United Party for National Development – UPND- has scooped both the Kafue East and West Parliamentary seats in Kafue district. In Kafue West Returning officer KAHEKO KAFUTI declared OBVIOUS MWALITETA of Kafue West as winner after he polled 13,932 votes.
